class.name: FlowFrame
class.brief_description: A titled, colored rectangle that groups nodes in the graph editor.
class.description: A [FlowFrame] is a purely visual helper of the graph editor: a rectangle with a title and a color behind a group of nodes. Frames are stored in [member FlowGraph.frames] and are ignored at runtime. The frame lists the ids of the nodes it groups in [member node_ids]; when a node is removed with [method FlowGraph.remove_node], its id is removed from every frame. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var frame := FlowFrame.new() frame.title = "Intro" frame.rect = Rect2(-20, -40, 460, 140) frame.node_ids = PackedInt32Array([start_id, wait_id]) graph.frames = [frame] [/gdscript] [csharp] var frame = new FlowFrame { Title = "Intro", Rect = new Rect2(-20, -40, 460, 140), NodeIds = [startId, waitId] }; graph.Frames = [frame]; [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

members.member: The ids of the nodes of the graph that belong to the frame.
Position and size of the frame in graph editor coordinates (pixels), the same space as [member FlowNode.editor_position].
The title shown at the top of the frame.
